summary:
Comprehensive plan for Phase 2:
1. Gradual 80% Background Dimming over 4 seconds on Books & Audio Books stages.
2. Performance optimization & visual clipping fixes: single-card template abstraction, stagger entrance queue (3 items/sec), pointer-interaction decoupling, and topbar popover overlap fixes.
3. Fullscreen Reader mode toggle with top-of-screen hover exit on Desktop and tap exit on Mobile.
4. Audiobook Background Ambient YouTube Player with 50% dimming, mute toggle, and random selection from the 268 relaxation video archive.
5. Replaced orb text titles with custom transparent WebP images matching X and ALBUMS dimensions.
